notes: appliedmath-brown-edu-community-phd-alumni-aa57f8 (live, 401 rows): chunk institution string is '(unknown)' and is copied as such, but the page is Brown University, Division of Applied Mathematics ('Ph.D. in Applied Mathematics at Brown'). Page banner says it 'does not yet represent a comprehensive list of all Ph.D. graduates'. Table columns are 'Ph.D. Recipient | Thesis Title | Advisor | Professional Snapshot' under year headings grouped by decade; the page does not label the year explicitly, it is recorded as 'graduation' because the heading context is 'Ph.D. Alumni'/'Ph.D. Recipient'. Year headings 1980-1994, 1997 and 2009 exist but contain only empty placeholder rows (no names), so no records; no headings at all for 1980s names. Professional Snapshot cell is written as 'After receiving Ph.D.: <employer>, <title> Currently: <employer>, <title>' (a few 2021-2023 rows say 'First job after Ph.D.:'); destination/position were split at the LAST comma of the first-job phrase and the unsplit phrase is kept verbatim in note ('... (as written): ...'); the 'Currently:' phrase is kept in note as a later move, never as destination. Rows whose first-job phrase has no comma got destination only (Oren Freifeld 'MIT CSAIL', Xiu Yang 'Pacific Northwest National Laboratory', Zhongqiang (Handy) Zhang 'Worcester Polytechnic', Andrew Nixon 'Self-Employed'); Dongkun Zhang 2019 gives only 'Quantitative Researcher' with no employer, so destination null and position set. Rows with an empty first-job phrase but a 'Currently:' value (e.g. Huan Lei 2012, Kristina Mallory 2021) have destination null and the current job only in note. Multi-comma employers to double check: 'Water Group, IBM' (Seshu Tirupathi 2014), 'Simons Foundation, Flatiron Institute' (Leroy Jia 2018), 'University of Michigan, Ann Arbor' (Clark Bowman 2018), 'Adobe, Inc.' (Michael Burkhart 2019), 'Brown & MIT' joint postdoc (Xiaoliang Wan 2007). Names are copied exactly, including the 'Dr.' prefix used on 1995-1999 rows, a garbled 1963 name 'TzsNiller', suffixes like 'Jr.'/'III', and page typos in thesis/advisor cells (e.g. 'igh order WENO scheme', 'George Karniadakis.', 'Johnny Guzman' vs 'Johnny Guzmán'). Erik Bergland 2024 thesis cell begins 'Title:' as written. 1945-1979 rows carry names only (no thesis, advisor or jobs).
